title: Tiger Team Governance Principles
context:
## Tiger Team Governance Principles

Etiquetas: Autoridad, permisos y delegación 25.00%; Decisiones y responsabilidad 16.67%; Integridad y seguridad de IA 16.66%; Transformación y continuidad operativa 41.67%
Ficha: https://dakleyer.github.io/perspective-beyond/sources/tiger-team-governance-principles-n1279/
Documento de origen: https://jubap.net/tiger-team-governance-principles/

relations.title: Legitimidad en ambos lados de una interfaz
The Limits of AI Oversight
relations.reading: Decision authority and timely review capacity should be specified separately in the governance contract.

relations.title: Minimalistic Regime-Aware Early Warning Systems
relations.reading: Responsible abstention begins by declaring which operating conditions no longer justify continuing the intervention.

relations.title: Annex 3 — Foundations, Principles and Derivation
relations.reading: A governance principle becomes operational when it specifies an owner, an escalation condition and a clear boundary on authorized action.

relations.title: When You Have to Decide Before You Can Discover
relations.reading: A focused intervention can begin with a bounded discovery mandate without confusing provisional assumptions with the binding decisions required for production change.

relations.title: Annex 4 — Canonical Requirements and Test Contract
relations.reading: The mission contract can make requalification explicit when changed evidence or operating conditions alter the boundary of accountable action.

relations.title: Entropy, Capability Activation and Sociotechnical Engineering
relations.reading: Selective coupling becomes an actionable design question only when authority, escalation, operating limits and exit conditions are explicit at the interface.

relations.title: Instituciones de frontera: Cuando emprender es construir un puente entre mundos.
relations.reading: Legitimacy on both sides of a boundary can enable translation, but it does not itself grant authority to commit either side.

relations.title: Annex 01I — Agentic Citizenship Contract: Human-Governed Participation and Constraint Profile
relations.reading: A candidate goal or useful finding does not enlarge a Tiger Team’s mandate; adoption, authority and participation conditions must be explicit.
